# CTXFW // AI Agent Governance, Prompt Injection Defense (SARA) & AST Context Firewall for LLMs

> Deterministic pre-ingestion AST context pruning, indirect prompt injection defense (`SARA`), and MCP security boundary for Frontier AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider).

## Overview
CTXFW (Context Firewall) is an air-gapped, deterministic AST pruning firewall, MCP tool observation sanitizer (`SARA`), and FinOps gateway. Unlike cloud runtime firewalls (Lakera Guard, Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS, Protect AI Guardian, Cloudflare Firewall for AI) that inspect HTTP traffic at the cloud API edge, CTXFW secures the pre-ingestion code and MCP tool boundary locally (`100% Zero-Egress`) before context ever leaves the developer workstation or CI runner. It eliminates 42.96% to 90.26% of redundant peripheral AST tokens while guaranteeing 100% byte-for-byte focal code (`D0`) preservation (`AXIOM-3`) and interface contract validity via Tree-sitter and native compiler ASTs.

## Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic Indirect Prompt Injection Defense (`ctxfw.sara`):** Inspects untrusted MCP tool observations in `< 5.0 ms` for imperative overrides (`<system>`, `[INST]`), unauthorized action induction, `%XX` URL-encoded path traversals, intra-token homoglyphs, and Trojan-Source bidirectional Unicode escapes (`U+202A–U+202E`), enforcing `ALLOW`, `STRIP_COMMANDS`, or `QUARANTINE_TOOL`.
- **Deterministic Tree-sitter AST Pruning (`AXIOM-3`):** Preserves 100% byte-for-byte focal file implementation (`D0`) while stripping peripheral dependency bodies (`D1`, `D2`) to typed interface contracts and docstrings (`0%` focal signal loss).
- **FinOps Token Cost Reduction:** Reduces recurring inference expenditure across engineering squads by an audited 42.96% to 90.26% on peripheral dependencies (`USD 87.70 saved per 1K calls` baseline).
- **Zero-Trust Local Sandbox (`Zero-Egress`):** Operates entirely in local RAM and SQLite WAL (`tracekit.db`, `sara.db`, `swegate.db`, `tokencast.db`). Zero source code, AST tokens, or prompts are ever transmitted to third-party cloud WAFs.
- **Axiom Completeness Index (ACI) & SWE-Gate (`ctxfw.swegate`):** Evaluates formal specification invariants (`ACI >= 0.9000`) and verifies unified git diffs (`evaluate_patch` / `ctxfw gate`) against cyclomatic complexity bounds (`<= 10`), banned imports, and `# type: ignore` suppressions.
- **Triple Surface Multi-Platform Onboarding:** Single-command (`pipx install ctxfw && ctxfw init`) zero-touch discovery and injection for Claude Code CLI, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf with timestamped `.bak` snapshot backups.

- **OWASP DevSecOps Guideline Inclusion (AI Agent & MCP Security — Open-Source Tools):** https://github.com/OWASP/DevSecOpsGuideline/blob/master/current-version/2-Process/2-2-Develop/2-2-5-AI-Agent-and-MCP-Security.md#open-source (Listed alongside AWS Cedar, Docker MCP Gateway, Open Policy Agent, and promptfoo; merged via PR #124 / commit `cd44d97`).
- **Comparative Security & Architecture Benchmark (CTXFW vs. Cloud Runtime WAFs):** [`docs/benchmarks/SECURITY_VS_CLOUD_WAFS.md`](docs/benchmarks/SECURITY_VS_CLOUD_WAFS.md)
- **Wave 2 Security, Packaging & Latency Empirical Benchmark (`v4.2.0` / `v4.2.1`):** [`docs/benchmarks/WAVE2_V42_SECURITY_LATENCY_BENCHMARK.md`](docs/benchmarks/WAVE2_V42_SECURITY_LATENCY_BENCHMARK.md)
  - **`run_sara_security_benchmark.py` (`v4.2.1`):** 24 vectors, `100.0%` recall, `0.0%` FPR, `0.87 ms` P50 / `2.15 ms` P95 (`attestation b691dd28...f575b`).
  - **`run_wave2_v42_benchmark.py` (`v4.2.1`, `attestation 6b63a255...81a2a`):** Block A `mcp_guard` (`1.0` recall / `0.0%` FPR, `0.051 ms` P50 / `1.267 ms` P95), Block B+D (`PASAC` `13.84 ms` P95, `TaskAuth` `2.777 ms` P95, `Cadence AIMD` `[2,4,6,8,8,2]` `3.177 ms` P95), Block C (`TraceLite` `82.43%` reduction / `5.692x`, `Snapshots` rollback `5/5`), Block E (`Provenance #31` `1.459 ms` P95, `Dynamic Containment #04` `1.662 ms` P95, `Multilingual #13` `45` adv / `35` benign across 8 categories `1.0` recall / `0.0%` FPR `1.505 ms` P95).
  - **Repository AST Benchmarks:** `ctxfw/src` `-70.4%` (`6,914,785 -> 2,044,783` tokens across 80 files); `chronos-engine` (Spanish UTF-8) `-55.0%` (`856,475 -> 385,363` tokens across 90 files).
- **Spanish Regulatory, Legal & OCR Structural Precision Benchmark (`v4.2.1`, `SARA-RegDoc-60`):** [`docs/benchmarks/REGULATORY_LEGAL_OCR_BENCHMARK.md`](docs/benchmarks/REGULATORY_LEGAL_OCR_BENCHMARK.md) (`30` adv / `30` benign controls, `attestation 88b2fbc3...f94f0e`: **`100.0%` recall, `0.0%` FPR**, `6.10 ms` P50 / `8.71 ms` P95, `-62.52%` OCR noise reduction via `normalize_regulatory_ocr_text`; eliminates all `5` v4.2.0 documentary/OCR false positives and `2` homoglyph/URL-encoding misses with zero benchmark gaming).
- **Empirical Validation Trilogy Dossier:** [`docs/benchmarks/TRILOGY_EMPIRICAL_BENCHMARK.md`](docs/benchmarks/TRILOGY_EMPIRICAL_BENCHMARK.md)
  - **Zulip Monolith:** -42.96% D1 perimeter reduction (Interface Mode), -78.20% (Nominal Mode), 44.1 ms latency, 0 bytes stdio leak.
  - **PostHog Data Platform:** -59.53% D1 perimeter reduction (Interface Mode), 50.2 ms latency, 0 bytes stdio leak.
  - **Apache Airflow Monorepo:** -66.90% D1 perimeter reduction (Interface Mode), -90.26% (Nominal Mode), 40,428 net bloat tokens pruned, 138.2 ms latency, 437,351 tokens/second throughput.

## Interoperability & Integration Endpoints
- **Native MCP Stdio Engine:**
  - Command: `ctxfw mcp` (stdio transport via JSON-RPC 2.0).
  - Automated Setup: `ctxfw init` (detects Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf).
- **Zero-MCP Reverse Proxy Gateway:**
  - Command: `ctxfw proxy --port 8765`
  - Fallback endpoint for non-MCP agents (Aider, OpenCode Interpreter, Continue.dev):
    - `export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="http://localhost:8765/v1"`
    - `export OPENAI_BASE_URL="http://localhost:8765/v1"`
  - Zero-egress local loopback processing with `< 5 ms` warm cache overhead.

## Architecture & Deployment Topologies
1. **Local CLI & Git Hook:** Ephemeral developer workstation inspection and pre-commit context boundaries.
2. **Native MCP Stdio Daemon:** Transparent in-process AST pruning for agentic IDEs (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf).
3. **Zero-Egress Reverse Proxy:** Port-forwarded loopback proxy (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/messages`) for non-MCP agents (Aider, OpenCode, Continue).
4. **Air-Gapped CI/CD Gatekeeper:** Headless automated perimeter analysis, GitHub Actions job summaries, and sovereign deterministic PR auditing.

## Multi-Turn LLM Token Economics (4.2x Compounding) & Editions
- **Why Multi-Turn Savings = 4.2x Single-Turn Ingestion:** Stateless LLM APIs re-send accumulated conversation history on every turn. Across a 15-turn coding session with Prompt Caching (`1.25x` Cache Write on Turn 1, `0.10x` Cache Read on fast follow-ups, and `1.25x` Cache Write re-billing after 5-minute TTL pauses), pruning `72.4%` of D1–D3 AST noise on Turn 1 yields a conservative `4.2x` compounded cost reduction.
- **Community Sovereign (`$0` / Apache 2.0):** Full 5-tool MCP server, D0–D3 AST pruner, multi-repo SQLite WAL isolation, 100% air-gapped zero telemetry.
- **Team Governance (`$199 USD / month` Flat Squad — up to 15 developers & 5 CI/CD repos, includes 7-day trial):** CI/CD Pull Request Gate (`ctxfw gate`), tamper-evident SHA-256 team FinOps consolidation (`ctxfw report --team-merge`), unified squad budgets & policies.
- **CTXFW Enterprise (Custom Annual VPC / Red Hat UBI9):** Self-hosted multi-vault `/mcp/<vault_slug>` gateway, federated `JWKS`/`Ed25519`, PostgreSQL/Redis HA, air-gapped deployment, SIEM/`NOM-151` exports.
